item.title: 🔴 Akira hackers disable EDR with Safe Mode, steal data but fail to encrypt
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups and endpoint defenses.
An Akira ransomware affiliate disabled the endpoint detection and response (EDR) solution on a compromised system by restarting the machine into Safe Mode with Networking. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 11h ago
